name: SHG
note: Front-of-shirt partner of NEOM SC per the club's 24 December 2025 announcement, which calls SHG a "national investment boutique" and names its CEO Mohammed Al Garafi (Exclusive Investment Partner, three seasons); also second front sponsor of Al-Nassr (433FC). SHG's own site (shg.sa) links its social profiles only to a LinkedIn company page at /company/the-syndicate-holding-group, but no openable page states SHG's full legal name or who owns it, so there is no ownership claim and it stays unrated.
